recipes.name: Creamy Cherry Tomato Salad with Fresh Basil, Corn and Onion
ingredients_raw: 1 small red onion, quartered and thinly sliced

steps.text: Salt tomatoes in a bowl and set aside. Whisk together mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar and garlic; set aside. Add corn, basil, onion and raisins to tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper, and toss with dressing.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Cherry Tomato Salad with Fresh Basil, Corn and Onion
raw_recipe.description: This cherry tomato-corn salad flavored with raisins and basil holds up well for summer picnics. Simply cut the raw corn from the cob -- no need to even cook it. Raisins are a surprise sweet addition.

review.reviewBody: Loved It! Made exactly as directed. Used fresh basil, corn, etc. Everything as directed. Stop fooling around with this recipe you guys - it's great the way it is. I served it was grilled apple-chiken sausages I buy at Trader Joes. Fantastic! If you make it the way it's written you'll love it too.
A great flavor mix! Used shallots (no green/red onions) and doubled the dressing b/c I added small WW pasta. Everyone loved it. Fresh basil is key! This goes in my rotation. Delicious!

Another great recipe for a vegatarian daughter in a house full of meat lovers. I grilled the corn in foil w/EEO and salt/peppers since I was grilling chicken for other family members. Also didn't use raisins. Family really liked it, great summer dish.

This really isn't a review of the recipe the way it's suppose to be made . But when I read the recipe I thought wow this would make a really good side dish warmed up . Yesterday I had leftover corn on the cob so I thought great time to give it a try . The only changes I made to the ingredients was left out the mayo & sour cream , used white wine vinegar because I didn't have rice vinegar . I also used dried onions . What I did was add a little olive oil to a tin pan added the rest of the ingredients , they sat for a bit while I cooked the rest of the meal . Then put them on the BBQ to warm them up . We were having Med. seasoned fish and baked potatoes it went perfect with them . So thanks for the recipe to inspire me .
I used canned corn(drained). It was great! I can't wait to make it with fresh corn!
I made this per recipe, except I used Apple cider vinegar as I didn't have Rice wine vinegar. Turned out great! And the raisins definitely " make this recipe". I plan to make more today!

I have made this recipe several times and it is always a hit. This time I use frozen corn instead of fresh corn. Still good. 

I didn’t have fresh garlic so I used garlic powder. Not the same.

 I always used dried cranberries, which is how it was made when I first had it. Gives it a slightly tart taste.

I selected this recipe because I had some grape tomatoes I needed to use. Didn't have fresh corn but I defrosted some frozen kernels under running water. Didn't have enough fresh basil either, so added some dry into the dressing and then lots of chopped fresh parsley in the salad. Would I make this again? I think so, but I'd definitely make it at least a couple of hours ahead of time instead of putting it together at the last minute and I would omit the raisins.

I have made this several times, including a vegan version using vegan sour cream and mayo. My vegan friends LOVED IT! Mine version is more of a corn salad with tomatoes because I cut the amount of tomatoes in half. Just my personal preference. Otherwise, I make it just as directed Excellent!
Didn't add the raisins and used light sour cream and a reduced amount of olive oil mayo. Was wonderful with fresh sweet summer corn...will definitely make again!
This was a wonderful, fresh addition to our summer meal. I would omit the raisins next time (just didn't seem to work with the other flavors), but loved everything else. Easy to make and delish!
Made for a picnic and everyone loved it! Super easy to make.

This salad is spectacular! Fresh summer ingredients, quick and easy to put together, and if there’s any left it’s even better the next day! I served it at a large get-together and everyone raved about it.

09.11.16 ~ A delicious corn-tomato salad with a twist. That twist is the raisins. I made the recipe as written, but did think about omitting the raisins. They add a slight sweetness to the salad and a totally different texture. I enjoyed them, my husband picked them out. A very good salad that I will be making again, part with the raisins, part sans raisins.

I had a lot of little cherry tomatoes from Hubs' garden that I wanted to use, so I thought I’d give this recipe a try. I halved the recipe using a can of corn, drained, as I didn’t have fresh, and I used currants because I didn’t have raisins. This was good, but it didn’t wow me. I think Hubs liked it better than I did. He had no problems polishing off the leftovers the next day.
made no changes and love it so do all my guests it is a wonderful taste and look ty for this recipe
Added diced jalapeños, lime juice, and omitted raisins. Was delicious.
Yum! This was wonderful! I didn't add the raisins, thinking others may not like that addition but will next time, or dried currants would be great also.

I'm not a tomato lover but I really liked this salad. I was surprised how well the flavors worked. I used frozen corn (thawed) because I didn't have any fresh and I used dried currents instead of the raisins. I'll definitely make it again. I'd love to try it with fresh corn.
Love, love, love this salad. It is so different. The raisins are a must. Sounds weird, I know but make it to the recipe and you will be surprised how great it is
